40004032.author: पदार्थः
40004032.content: ततः then, राघवः scion of the Raghus (Rama), रम्यम् lovely, तमसातीरम् bank of Tamasa, आश्रित्य having taken refuge, सीताम् Sita, उद्वीक्ष्य having looked at, सौमित्रिम् Sumitra's son (Lakshmana), इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40004032.author: Translation
40004032.content: The scion of the Raghus (Rama), having taken shelter on the lovely bank of Tamasa, glanced at Sita and said to Lakshmana thus:

40004033.author: पदार्थः
40004033.content: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, वनम् to the forest, प्रहिताः having been sent, अद्य today, इयम् this, वनवासस्य exile in the forest, पूर्वा first, निशा night, उत्कण्ठितुम् longing in your mind, न अर्हसि does not behove you, ते भद्रम् wish you well.

40004033.author: Translation
40004033.content: O Lakshmana, this happens to be the first night of our exile. You should not have any longing in your mind. Wish you well

40004034.author: पदार्थः
40004034.content: यथानिलयम् to their respective abodes, आयद्भिः by those returning, मृगद्विजैः by wild animals and birds, निलीनानि concealed themselves in their hideouts, शून्यानि deserted,  अरण्यानि forests, समन्ततः all over, रुदन्तीव as if crying, पश्य see.

40004034.author: Translation
40004034.content: Look at the deserted forest. The wild animals and birds have returned to their hideouts. They fill the air with their cries.

40004035.author: पदार्थः
40004035.content: अद्य now, मम पितुः my father's, राजधानी capital, अयोध्या नगरी city of Ayodhya, सस्त्रीपुंसा   with men and women, गतान् having gone ( to the forest), अस्मान् about us, शोचिष्यति must be mourning, नसंशयः no doubt.

40004035.author: Translation
40004035.content: There is no doubt that now the men and women of Ayodhya, father's capital city must be bewailing our departure.

40004036.author: पदार्थः
40004036.content: नरव्याघ्र O tiger (best) among men, मनुजाः the people, बहुभिः many, गुणैः virtues, राजानम् to the king, त्वां च to you, मां च to me, तथा similarly, शत्रुघ्न भरतौ to Satrughna and Bharata, अनुरक्ताः हि are indeed attached.

40004036.author: Translation
40004036.content: O best of men because of our many virtues, the people (of Ayodhya) are indeed loyal to the king, to you, to me and to Satrughna and Bharata, too.

40004037.author: पदार्थः
40004037.content: पितरं च also father, यशस्विनीम् illustrious, मातरं च also mother, अनुशोचामि I am distressed, तौ both of them, अभीक्ष्णशः repeatedly, रुदन्तौ while weeping, अन्धौ blind, अपि वा भवेताम् will they become.

40004037.author: Translation
40004037.content: What distresses me is the thought that both father and illustrious mother may become blind by repeated weeping (over us).

40004038.author: पदार्थः
40004038.content: धर्मात्मा righteous, भरतः Bharata, धर्मार्थकामसहितैः with dharma, artha and kama, वाक्यैः  words, मे my, पितरम् father, मातरं च and mother, आश्वासयिष्यति खलु will console indeed.

40004038.author: Translation
40004038.content: Righteous Bharata will indeed console parents with words in conformity with  dharma, artha and kama.

40004039.author: पदार्थः
40004039.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अहं I, भरतस्य Bharata's, अनृशंसत्वम् lack of wickedness, पुनः पुनः again again, विचिन्त्य after reflecting about, पितरम् father, मातरं च and mother, नानुशोचामि have no regrets.

40004039.author: Translation
40004039.content: As I reflect again and again on the benevolent nature of Bharata, there is no concern in me about my parents, O Lakshmana

40004040.author: पदार्थः
40004040.content: नरव्याघ्र O best of men, माम् me, अनुव्रजता while accompanying, त्वया by you, कार्यम् good deed, कृतम् has been done, वैदेह्याः Sita, रक्षणार्थे for protection, सहायता assistance,  अन्वेष्टव्या हि to be sought for.

40004040.author: Translation
40004040.content: You, O Lakshmana, the best among men, have done a good job by accompanying me. Otherwise assistance for Sita's protection would have been sought (necessary).

40004041.author: पदार्थः
40004041.content: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, अद्य today, इमां निशाम् this night, अद्भिरेव with water only, वत्स्यामि I will live, विविधे different kinds, वन्ये forest products, सत्यपि available, एतत् this one, मह्यम् to me, रोचते हि is my preference.

40004041.author: Translation
40004041.content: O Lakshmana, I shall live this night on water alone. I prefer it, though various kinds of forest products are available.

40004042.author: पदार्थः
40004042.content: राघवः Rama, सौमित्रिम् to Lakshmana, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having said, सौम्य O gentle one, त्वम् अश्वेषु about horses, अप्रमत्तः भव be careful, इति thus, सुमन्त्रमपि to Sumantra also, उवाच ह said.

40004042.author: Translation
40004042.content: Having said so to Lakshmana, he turned to Sumantra to say O gentle friend, tend the horses with care.

40004043.author: पदार्थः
40004043.content: सः सुमन्त्रः that Sumantra, सूर्ये Sun, अस्तम् was setting, समुपागते was setting, अश्वान् horses, संयम्य tethered, प्रभूतयवसान् with abundant fodder, कृत्वा having made, प्रत्यनन्तरः बभूव sat in their proximity.

40004043.author: Translation
40004043.content: As the Sun was setting, Sumantra tethered the horses, fed them with abundant fodder and sat close to them.

40004044.author: पदार्थः
40004044.content: सूतः charioteer, शिवाम् auspicious, सन्ध्याम् Sandhya, उपास्य having worshipped, रात्रिम्  night, उपस्थिताम् having arrived, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सौमित्रिणा सह along with Lakshmana, रामस्य of Rama, शयनम् bed, चक्रे made.

40004044.author: Translation
40004044.content: Then the charioteer worshipping the auspicious Sandhya (twilight), and seeing the night approach made  bed for Rama and Lakshmana.

40004045.author: पदार्थः
40004045.content: तमसातीरे on the bank of Tamasa, वृक्षदलैः with leaves of trees, कृताम् made, तां शय्याम् that bed, वीक्ष्य having seen, रामः Rama, सभार्यः along with his wife, सौमित्रिणा सार्धम along with Lakshmana, संविवेश ह lay down.

40004045.author: Translation
40004045.content: Having seen the bed of leaves made ready on the bank of Tamasa, Rama lay down there along with Sita and Lakshmana.

40004046.author: पदार्थः
40004046.content: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सम्प्रसुप्तम् fallen asleep, सभार्यम् along with wife, तं भ्रातरम् that brother, वीक्ष्य having seen, सूताय to the charioteer (Sumantra), रामस्य Rama's, विविधान् various  गुणान् virtues, कथयामास narrated.

40004046.author: Translation
40004046.content: Having seen that his brother along with his wife had fallen asleep, Lakshmana narrated the many virtues of Rama to Sumantra.

40004047.author: पदार्थः
40004047.content: तमसातीरे on the bank of river Tamasa, रामस्य Rama's, गुणान् virtues, सूतस्य (in) the chrioteer's (presence), ब्रुवतः telling, सौमित्रेः Lakshmana, तां रात्रिम् that night, जाग्रतोह्येव by keeping awake, रविः the Sun, उदितः arose.

40004047.author: Translation
40004047.content: Lakshmana continued to describe Rama's virtues to the charioteer, keeping awake that entire night on the bank of Tamasa until the Sun rose.

40004048.author: पदार्थः
40004048.content: रामः Rama, प्रकृतिभिः with the subjects, गोकुलाकुलतीरायाः of that bank crowded with herds of cattle, तमसायाः Tamasa, विदूरतः not very far, तां रात्रिम् that night, तत्र there, अवसत् lived.

40004048.author: Translation
40004048.content: Rama spent the night with his subjects not very far from the bank of Tamasa which was crowded with herds of cattle.

40004049.author: पदार्थः
40004049.content: महातेजाः brilliant, सः रामः that Rama, उत्थाय च having risen, ताः those, प्रकृतीः subjects, निशाम्य च having seen, पुण्यलक्षणम् having auspicious qualities, भ्रातरम् brother, लक्ष्मणम् addressing Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् he said.

40004049.author: Translation
40004049.content: On getting up, the brilliant Rama looked at his subjects and said to his brother Lakshmana full of noble qualities:

40004050.author: पदार्थः
40004050.content: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, सौमित्रे son of Sumitra, अस्मद्व्यपेक्षान् due to their affection for us, गृहेष्वपि even in their homes, निरपेक्षान् indifferent, साम्प्रतम् now, वृक्षमूलेषु at the foot of the trees, संसुप्तान् are fast asleep, पश्य you may see.

40004050.author: Translation
40004050.content: O Lakshmana, son of Sumitra look at these people, fast alseep under the trees. Out of affection for us, they are even indifferent to their home.

40004051.author: पदार्थः
40004051.content: एते पौराः these citizens, अस्मन्निवर्तने on our return, यथा as, नियमम् resolve,  कुर्वन्ति are doing, प्राणानपि even life also, न्यसिष्यन्ति will give up, निश्चयं तु determination, न त्यक्ष्यन्ति will not abandon.

40004051.author: Translation
40004051.content: On seeing the people's resolve to take us back, it appears they are prepared to give up their lives rather than abandon their determination.

40004052.author: पदार्थः
40004052.content: यावदेव so long as, संसुप्ताः they are asleep, तावदेव so long, वयम् we, लघु quickly, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य mounting, अकुतोभयम् without fear, पन्थानम् on our way, गच्छाम we shall go.

40004052.author: Translation
40004052.content: While they are asleep, we shall quickly mount the chariot and fearlessly proceed on the way.

40004053.author: पदार्थः
40004053.content: अतः therefore, माम् about me, अनुरक्ताः attached, इक्ष्वाकुपुरवासिनः inhabitants of the city of the Ikshvakus, भूयोऽपि again, वृक्षमूलानि at the foot of the trees, संश्रिताः having taken refuge, इदानीम् now, भूयोऽपि again, न स्वपेयुः should not sleep.

40004053.author: Translation
40004053.content: These loyal inhabitants of Ayodhya, the city of the Ikshvakus will no more sleep again shelterd under the trees.

40004054.author: पदार्थः
40004054.content: पौराः the citizens, नृपात्मजैः by the sons of the king, आत्मकृतात् done by themselves, दुःखात्  from the sufferings, विप्रमोच्या हि are to be delivered, पुरवासिनः people of the city, आत्मना  by themselves, दुःखेन suffering, न योज्याः हि are not to be united.

40004054.author: Translation
40004054.content: The prince should deliver the citizens from the sufferings caused by themselves but should not make them suffer on their account.

40004055.author: पदार्थः
40004055.content: साक्षात् incarnate of, धर्ममिव righteousness, स्थितम् remaining, रामम् to Rama, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्राज्ञ O sagacious, मे to me, तथा that way, रोचते is agreeable, क्षिप्रम् quickly, आरुह्यताम् let us board the chariot, इति thus, अब्रवीत् spoken.

40004055.author: Translation
40004055.content: Lakshmana said to Rama who was the very image of like righteousness O wise one, I like this (proposal). Let us quickly mount the chariot.

40004056.author: पदार्थः
40004056.content: अथ then, श्रीमान् glorious, रामः Rama, सुमन्त्रम् addressing Sumantra, अब्रवीत् said, प्रभो O master charioteer, रथः chariot, युज्यताम् be yoked, ततः then, अरण्यम् to the forest, गमिष्यामि  shall go, इतः from here, शीघ्रम् quickly, गच्छ I shall go.

40004056.author: Translation
40004056.content: Then glorious Rama addressing Sumantra said O master charioteer, harness the chariot. I shall (let us) quickly leave for the forest.

40004057.author: पदार्थः
40004057.content: ततः thereupon, सः सूतः that charioteer (Sumantra), त्वरितः in haste , स्यन्दनम् the chariot, तैः those, हयोत्तमैः splendid horses, योजयित्वा having harnessed, अथ and, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, रामाय for Rama, प्रत्यवेदयत् informed.

40004057.author: Translation
40004057.content: Thereupon the charioteer hurriedly harnessed the splendid horses to the chariot and informed Rama with folded hands:

40004058.author: पदार्थः
40004058.content: महाबाहो O longarmed one, रथिनाम् among the charioteers, वर best, ते for you, अयं रथः  this chariot, युक्तः has been yoked, त्वम् you, स सीतः with Sita, सह लक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, अरोहस्व mount, ते भद्रम् all the best.

40004058.author: Translation
40004058.content: O best among riders the chariot has been harnessed. O mightyarmed one, board it along with Sita and Lakshmana. All the best

40004059.author: पदार्थः
40004059.content: सपरिच्छदः with his belongings, राघवः Rama, तं स्यन्दनम् that chariot, अधिष्ठाय having mounted, शीघ्रगाम् rapidly flowing, आकुलावर्ताम् agitated with whirlpools, तमसां नदीम् Tamasa river, अतरत् crossed.

40004059.author: Translation
40004059.content: Rama (along with others) mounted the chariot with his belongings, crossed the rapidly flowing Tamasa agitated with whirlpools.

40004060.author: पदार्थः
40004060.content: महाबाहुः mightyarmed, श्रीमान् gracious, सः that Rama, सन्तीर्य having crossed, शिवम्  auspicious, अकण्टकम् without thorns (sufferings), भयदर्शिनाम् even for the timid, अभयम् arousing confidence, महामार्गम् highway, प्रापद्यत reached.

40004060.author: Translation
40004060.content: Having crossed the river, the mightyarmed and gracious Rama proceeded on the auspicious and thornless highway arousing confidence even in the timid.

40004061.author: पदार्थः
40004061.content: रामः Rama, पौराणाम् citizens', मोहनार्थम् to elude, सूतम् to the charioteer, वचः those words, अब्रवीत् said, सारथे O charioteer, त्वम् you, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय having mounted, उदङ्मुखः in northerly direction, प्रयाहि you may proceed, मुहूर्तम् for a while, त्वरितम् speedily, गत्वा having gone, रथम् chariot, पुनः again, निवर्तय turn back, माम् about me, पौराः citizens, यथा how, न विद्युः will not know, तथा in that manner, समाहितः accomplish, कुरु you may act.

40004061.author: Translation
40004061.content: With the intention of confusing the citizens, Rama said to the charioteer, O Sumantra, having seated in the chariot proceed speedly for a while in northerly direction and again turn back the chariot. Accomplish this feat in such a manner that the citizens will not know (where we have gone).

40004062.author: पदार्थः
40004062.content: रामः Rama, पौराणाम् citizens', मोहनार्थम् to elude, सूतम् to the charioteer, वचः those words, अब्रवीत् said, सारथे O charioteer, त्वम् you, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय having mounted, उदङ्मुखः in northerly direction, प्रयाहि you may proceed, मुहूर्तम् for a while, त्वरितम् speedily, गत्वा having gone, रथम् chariot, पुनः again, निवर्तय turn back, माम् about me, पौराः citizens, यथा how, न विद्युः will not know, तथा in that manner, समाहितः accomplish, कुरु you may act.

40004062.author: Translation
40004062.content: With the intention of confusing the citizens, Rama said to the charioteer, O Sumantra, having seated in the chariot proceed speedly for a while in northerly direction and again turn back the chariot. Accomplish this feat in such a manner that the citizens will not know (where we have gone).

40004063.author: पदार्थः
40004063.content: सः सारथिः that charioteer, रामस्य Rama's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, तथा as instructed, चक्रे having done, प्रत्यागम्य having retuned, रामस्य to Rama, स्यन्दनम् chariot, प्रत्यवेदयत्  informed.

40004063.author: Translation
40004063.content: The charioteer did as instructed by Rama, returned to him with the chariot and informed (of its readiness).

40004064.author: पदार्थः
40004064.content: तदा then, स सीतौ with Sita, रघुवंशवर्धनौ perpetuating the race of Raghu, Rama and Lakshmana, सम्प्रयुक्तम् wellyoked, रथम् chariot, समास्थितौ were seated, ततः then, सः सारथिः the charioteer, येन पथा that way, तपोवनम् penancegroves, तुरङ्गमान् horses, प्रचोदयामास urged.

40004064.author: Translation
40004064.content: When Rama and Lakshmana, perpetuaters of the Raghu race along with Sita were seated on the wellyoked chariot, Sumantra urged the horses to move.

40004065.author: पदार्थः
40004065.content: ततः then, सः he Sumantra, प्रयाणमाङ्गल्यनिमित्तदर्शनात् having seen the auguries of auspiciousness during the journey, तं रथम् that chariot, उदङ्मुखम् northerly direction, चकार made, महारथः that great chariot, दाशरथिः Rama , ससारथिः with the charioteer, रथम् chariot, (सम्) आस्थाय having mounted, वनम् to the forest, ययौ went.

40004065.author: Translation
40004065.content: As it augurs well to travel north Sumantra placed the chariot in that direction. Thereafter that great charioteer, Rama, Sita and Lakshmana boarded the chariot and departed. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षट्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysixth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
